command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
cd /tmp/in
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c --quiet pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "pins ok: $(wc -l < pins.sha256) files"
lscpu | grep -iE 'model name|^cpu\(s\)|numa node\(s\)' > /tmp/cpu.txt; cat /tmp/cpu.txt
df -h /tmp | tail -1
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u real.py /tmp/in > /tmp/real.log 2>&1
RC=$?
echo "real.py exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
cat /tmp/real.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the workload failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'ASTROPY REAL OK' /tmp/real.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo DONE
